subworkflow_overview.name: quantify_pseudo_alignment
subworkflow_overview.purpose: Perform quantification with Salmon or Kallisto to produce count tables and SummarizedExperiment objects
subworkflow_overview.prerequisites: Requires input files like sample sheet, reads, indexes, transcript FASTA, and GTF

component_tools.role: Performs quantification using the Salmon pseudoalignment tool
component_tools.why_chosen: Salmon is a popular and accurate pseudoalignment tool for RNA-seq quantification

component_tools.role: Performs quantification using the Kallisto pseudoalignment tool
component_tools.why_chosen: Kallisto is another popular and fast pseudoalignment tool for RNA-seq quantification

component_tools.role: Generates a tx2gene mapping file required by downstream tools
component_tools.why_chosen: Needed to map transcript IDs to gene IDs for downstream analysis

component_tools.role: Imports the quantification results into R/Bioconductor SummarizedExperiment objects
component_tools.why_chosen: SummarizedExperiment is a common data structure for RNA-seq analysis in R

component_tools.role: Generates a unified SummarizedExperiment object at the gene level
component_tools.why_chosen: Gene-level quantification is often the starting point for many RNA-seq analyses

component_tools.role: Generates a unified SummarizedExperiment object at the transcript level
component_tools.why_chosen: Transcript-level quantification can provide additional insights in some analyses

data_flow.input: sample sheet, reads, indexes, transcript FASTA, GTF
transformations: Quantify reads using Salmon or Kallisto
Import quantification results into SummarizedExperiment objects
data_flow.output: Unified SummarizedExperiment objects at gene and transcript levels
data_flow.format_conversions: Converts quantification results into R/Bioconductor data structures

use_patterns.upstream: Preprocessing of raw reads (e.g., trimming, QC)
use_patterns.downstream: Downstream RNA-seq analysis (e.g., differential expression, pathway analysis)
use_patterns.variations: Can use either Salmon or Kallisto for quantification

parameter_interactions.interaction: Determines which pseudoalignment tool is used for quantification
Specifies whether Salmon should run in alignment mode or not
Overrides the automatically detected Salmon library type
Specifies the estimated fragment length required by Kallisto in single-end mode
Specifies the estimated standard error for fragment length required by Kallisto in single-end mode

checks_performed: Verify that quantification results are generated for all samples
Ensure that SummarizedExperiment objects are properly constructed
failure_modes: Quantification fails for one or more samples
recovery_actions: Investigate the cause of quantification failures and retry

subworkflow_overview.name: vcf_annotate_ensemblvep_snpeff
subworkflow_overview.purpose: Perform annotation with ensemblvep and/or snpeff and bgzip + tabix index the resulting VCF file. This subworkflow uses the scatter-gather method to run VEP/snpEff in parallel to increase throughput.

component_tools.role: Download the required Ensembl VEP cache files
alternatives: manual download and provision of cache files
component_tools.why_chosen: Automated download of required files

component_tools.role: Annotate the VCF file using Ensembl VEP
component_tools.why_chosen: Ensembl VEP is a widely used and comprehensive variant annotation tool

component_tools.role: Download the required SnpEff database files
alternatives: manual download and provision of database files
component_tools.why_chosen: Automated download of required files

component_tools.role: Annotate the VCF file using SnpEff
component_tools.why_chosen: SnpEff is a popular and widely used variant annotation tool

component_tools.role: Index the annotated VCF file using tabix
component_tools.why_chosen: Tabix is a widely used and efficient VCF indexing tool

component_tools.role: Compress the annotated VCF file using bgzip
component_tools.why_chosen: Bgzip is commonly used to compress VCF files

component_tools.role: Split the input VCF file into smaller chunks for parallel processing
component_tools.why_chosen: BCFtools plugin for efficient VCF splitting

component_tools.role: Concatenate the annotated VCF chunks back into a single file
component_tools.why_chosen: BCFtools concat is a reliable tool for merging VCF files

component_tools.role: Sort the final annotated VCF file
component_tools.why_chosen: BCFtools sort is a commonly used tool for sorting VCF files

data_flow.input: VCF file, optional FASTA file, and various configuration parameters
transformations: Split the input VCF file into smaller chunks
Annotate each VCF chunk using Ensembl VEP and/or SnpEff
Concatenate the annotated VCF chunks back into a single file
Sort the final annotated VCF file
Compress and index the final annotated VCF file
data_flow.format_conversions: VCF to compressed and indexed VCF

use_patterns.scenario: Annotate VCF files with Ensembl VEP and/or SnpEff
use_patterns.downstream: Downstream analysis of annotated VCF file
use_patterns.variations: Use only Ensembl VEP, only SnpEff, or both

parameter_interactions.interaction: Determines the number of VCF chunks to create for parallel processing
Specifies which annotation tools to use (Ensembl VEP, SnpEff, or both)

checks_performed: Ensure input VCF file is valid
Verify successful download and availability of Ensembl VEP cache and SnpEff database files
Check for successful annotation of each VCF chunk
Validate the final annotated VCF file
failure_modes: Input VCF file is missing or corrupted
Failure to download required cache or database files
Annotation failure for one or more VCF chunks
Issues with concatenation or sorting of the final VCF file
recovery_actions: Provide a valid input VCF file
Manually download and provide the required cache or database files
Investigate and fix issues with individual VCF chunk annotation
Troubleshoot and resolve issues with the final VCF file processing

subworkflow_overview.name: fastq_align_chromap
subworkflow_overview.purpose: Align high throughput chromatin profiles using Chromap then sort with samtools
subworkflow_overview.prerequisites: Requires FASTQ reads, genome index, and reference FASTA

component_tools.role: Aligns the input FASTQ reads to the reference genome
component_tools.why_chosen: Chromap is a fast and accurate aligner for chromatin profiling data

component_tools.role: Sorts the aligned BAM file
component_tools.why_chosen: Samtools is a widely used and efficient tool for BAM file manipulation

component_tools.role: Indexes the sorted BAM file
component_tools.why_chosen: Samtools is a widely used and efficient tool for BAM file manipulation

component_tools.role: Generates statistics for the aligned BAM file
component_tools.why_chosen: Samtools is a widely used and efficient tool for BAM file manipulation

component_tools.role: Generates index statistics for the aligned BAM file
component_tools.why_chosen: Samtools is a widely used and efficient tool for BAM file manipulation

component_tools.role: Generates flag statistics for the aligned BAM file
component_tools.why_chosen: Samtools is a widely used and efficient tool for BAM file manipulation

component_tools.role: Wraps the Samtools tools for sorting, indexing, and generating statistics
component_tools.why_chosen: Provides a convenient way to run multiple Samtools commands

data_flow.input: FASTQ reads, genome index, reference FASTA
transformations: Sort and index the BAM file using Samtools
Generate BAM file statistics using Samtools
data_flow.output: Sorted and indexed BAM file, BAM file statistics

use_patterns.scenario: Aligning chromatin profiling data (ChIP-seq, ATAC-seq, Hi-C)
use_patterns.downstream: Downstream analysis (peak calling, differential analysis, etc.)
use_patterns.variations: Can be used with different aligners, different parameter settings for Chromap

parameter_interactions.interaction: Chromap parameters can affect the alignment quality and performance
Samtools parameters can affect the sorting, indexing, and statistics generation

checks_performed: Check for successful Samtools sorting and indexing
Check for successful Samtools statistics generation
recovery_actions: Investigate the cause of the failure (e.g., check input data quality, resource availability)
Retry the failed step with adjusted parameters or resources
Provide informative error messages and logs to aid in troubleshooting
